method: Group kernel events by collective, CPU launch owner, message size and dtype; sum each rank before taking the eight-rank median. Temporal overlap is the intersection with the union of all non-NCCL GPU kernel intervals on that rank. Launch grid and block dimensions are copied from each kernel event and counted within its attributed group.
limitations: Source OP3 profiles, not an OP4 measurement; source arms are recorded explicitly.
Kernel durations may include waiting for other ranks and profiler overhead.
Exposed means no simultaneous non-NCCL GPU kernel, not a causal critical-path proof.
Do not sum group medians to reconstruct formal step time or a predicted speedup.
All ranks and all collectives are retained, including startup and outliers.
NCCL kernel entry-point names do not establish the actual algorithm or protocol: NCCL 2.27 can dispatch different algorithms/protocols through the same specialized entry.
Grid dimensions establish launched CTAs, not communicator channel capacity or per-message ring topology. No LL-to-Simple transition is inferred from these traces.
